200 days from 1762-10-21:  
1762 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100, not by 400).  
October has 31 days → days left in October after 21st: 10 → 190 days remain.  
November 30, December 31 → 61 days gone → 129 days remain into 1763.  
January 31, February 28 (1763 not leap), March 31, April 30 → 31+28+31+30=120 days → 9 days left → May 9, 1763.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1763-05-09
